description: Use when preparing for the second-stage Professional Engineer examination in Japan (技術士第二次試験) in the Information Engineering field (情報工学部門) — eligibility through practical experience, the written essays (必須科目Ⅰ, 選択科目Ⅱ-1・Ⅱ-2・Ⅲ) judged against the published competencies, the experience description, the oral examination, and self-scoring practice answers.
